description: Ministry of Public Administration - 5th Amendment to the service Minute of the Sri  Lanka Architects Service
categorisation: This gazette content pertains specifically to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Architects Service, detailing service conditions, promotion qualifications, and salary increments for public sector architects. It involves public service administration, recruitment criteria, and service regulations, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes.
